theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Duolingo/Disney inspired gamified edtech for kids. Needs to be extremely friendly, tactile, and highly engaging with thick rounded shapes and vibrant colors.

surface_strategies.buttons: The 'Duolingo' 3D Button: Flat vibrant background, extra rounded (rounded-2xl or rounded-full), heavy solid bottom border (border-b-4) of a darker shade. On active/click: translate-y-1, border-b-0, mt-1 to simulate physical pressing.
surface_strategies.cards: Soft white/dark background, high border radius (rounded-3xl), subtle diffuse shadow, 2px solid border in a very light tint of the primary color to make it pop.
surface_strategies.dashboard_widgets: Tactile Neo-Brutalism but soft. Thick borders, generous padding (p-6), distinct background colors for different states.

spacing_and_layout.general: Extremely generous padding (p-6, p-8). Elements must never feel cramped. Kids need large tap targets.
spacing_and_layout.grid_mode: Bento Grid for Dashboard, but with playful asymmetrical card sizes. Use wide gaps (gap-6 or gap-8).
spacing_and_layout.mobile_first: Navigation should prioritize a bottom tab bar on mobile (like Duolingo app) and a thick sidebar on desktop.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Scale up slightly (scale-105) for cards, bounce effect for icons.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer motion staggered entrance for list items. The mascot (Hashimjon) should float and bob continuously.

components_customization.shadcn_overrides: Override all Shadcn default radii to `rounded-2xl` or `rounded-full`. Remove the thin gray borders and replace with thicker (2px) tinted borders. Replace default gray hover states with tinted colorful hover states.
components_customization.forms: Inputs must be large (h-14), rounded-2xl, with thick borders that change to Primary Blue or Primary Pink on focus.
components_customization.progress_bars: Thick (h-4 or h-6), fully rounded, candy-striped or solid vibrant colors.

hero_island_map.description: 3D clay-style island map for the Knowledge Islands background

hashimjon_mascot.description: Cute 3D cartoon boy character representing Hashimjon

gamification_coins.description: 3D render of gold coins for XP, rewards, and leaderboards

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text inside the vibrant colored buttons is white and bold to maintain contrast. Drop shadows on text if overlaid on map.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements must have `data-testid` in kebab-case (e.g., `data-testid="start-lesson-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind with the custom colors: primaryPink, primaryPurple, primaryBlue, backgroundLight, backgroundDark, success, warning, danger.
Load Google Fonts Nunito (body) and Poppins (headings).
Build the 3D button component as described (flat bg, thick border-b, push down on active).
Implement a scrollable 'Knowledge Islands' path using standard flex/grid or absolute positioning over the map background, similar to a Candy Crush or Duolingo path.
Design the Student Dashboard with large, playful cards for XP, Streaks, and Daily Challenges.
In Dark Mode, the background becomes deep dark purple (#1A1525) and neon accents are used.
